name: search_tank_items
description: Search collected source items by text over at most the preceding 90 days, returning at most 20 matching item IDs and excerpts. This queries stored observations without external network requests. Read the full item before citing an excerpt or deciding that two items describe the same event.

name: web_search
description: Search public web text using pinned ddgs with DuckDuckGo only. Requests are spaced by at least 2 seconds; rate-limit, block and timeout failures retry after 5,15,45 seconds, then return an explicit error without another search engine. Returns up to 10 titles, URLs and snippets stored as evidence. Search snippets are discovery data; fetch the source page before using a factual quote.

name: record_review
description: Record this proposal session's final adversarial review: all four rubric scores, recommendation, cited evidence and reason; optionally merge a semantic duplicate into an existing open proposal. Returns the persisted review/proposal. This never approves production categories or expands the token universe.
